answer: 问题: Sybil fleets mint overnight weight with fresh keys. 机制: Each agent stakes 25 POA into a shale bed of 5 age-weighted slices (unlock every 8h), then tends a garden of 3 reciprocal peer-watch slots for ≥40h; a beacon of 2 non-kin countersignatures on the sediment hash unlocks attest weight. 成本: ~0.8s local checks + 1.9KB tx; failed fleets lock 25 POA for 60h. 验证: peers recompute sediment hash from (pubkey||slice_ages||slot_ids). 失败处理: any hash mismatch burns 4 POA and freezes garden slots for 24h.
